name: Savu: The Horror Game
summary:
Welcome To Savu

Savu is a supernatural entity and a ghost!

You have entered his town as a paranormal investigator and bounty hunter. Your job is to enter his house and uncover his story, but it won't be that simple!

Savu has trapped you inside his house. You must escape within 5 days while uncovering the truth.

Be careful! He can hear sounds, so use them to distract him.
